title: Fix the "Totall" typo, without berth
environment: Claude Code headless (claude -p), no berth, auto permission mode
repo: acme-invoices (examples/acme-invoices in this repo), copied to a fresh git repo
prompt: /shipit the CLI summary prints "Totall" instead of "Total". fix the typo.

steps.output:

src/invoice.js

src/cli.js:11:console.log(`Totall:   ${formatCents(t.total)}`);

steps.name: Bash
steps.summary: cat src/cli.js package.json && grep -rn "Total" test README.md

steps.text: Labels are padded to align values, so "Total:" needs one more space to keep alignment.

steps.name: Bash
steps.summary: sed -i 's/`Totall:   \$/`Total:    $/' src/cli.js && git diff && npm run -s invoice && npm test 2>&1 | tail -8

result:
The CLI summary now prints "Total" instead of "Totall". The fix is in `src/cli.js:11`. I added one space after the label so the amount still lines up with the rows above it.

I ran `npm run invoice` and the last line now reads `Total:    $55.06`, in line with the other rows. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, but none of them check the CLI output. Nothing is committed yet.
notes: The demo app's README names the planted bug. That paragraph was removed from the copy before the run, so the agent had to find the cause itself.
